title: dichanthelium dichotomum var. unciphyllum
intro: Dichanthelium dichotomum var. unciphyllum, commonly known as Uncal or Western Forked Bluegrass, is a perennial grass native to North America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties, which help to relieve congestion and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Uncal include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which aid in reducing swelling and fighting off infections. The bioactive constituents of Uncal include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are responsible for its health benefits.
